summary.text: JYSK AS (947 477 129), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 1988-06-10; address Tevlingveien 23, 1081 OSLO, Norge. Main industry is Retail sale of furniture, including mattresses and box springs (47.551); 1,314 registered employees; 116 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Inger Martina Pohjanen; Board chair: Rami Jensen; Auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-08-31): revenue NOK 3.34 bn, operating profit NOK 326.12 m, net profit NOK 264.57 m, equity NOK 180.36 m, total assets NOK 1.02 bn.
